name: ICC Profiles
description: ColorProfile (an ICC matrix-and-curve profile: RGB or gray, colourants in XYZ D50 after Bradford adaptation, gamma, table and parametric curves) with the built-in sRGB, Display P3 and linear sRGB profiles, and ProfileTransform between two profiles through the D50 PCS. Reading ICC bytes, writing them and the transform's body are stubs that throw ColorError.invalid("not built: <task>") until they land.
